title: Score-based confidence intervals for variance-covariance parameters in linear mixed models
Score-based confidence intervals for variance-covariance parameters in linear mixed models
summary: The paper addresses unreliable confidence intervals for variance-covariance parameters in linear mixed models when parameters are near or on the boundary. It proposes inverting a modified profile score statistic based on the restricted likelihood, with nuisance parameters estimated on an extended parameter set, and proves uniform asymptotic coverage. In the autism socialization example, the proposed 95% interval for the intercept-slope covariance ψ2 is (-34.566, -18.401), and simulations show near-nominal coverage where Wald, likelihood ratio, and constrained score intervals can fail.

"""Data loading for the WWGbook autism socialization example (Section 5.1)."""
from __future__ import annotations

import os
import tarfile

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

CACHE = os.environ.get(
    "REPRO_DATA_CACHE",
    os.path.join(os.path.expanduser("~"), ".cache", "datasets", "files"),
)

CRAN_URLS = [
    "https://cran.r-project.org/src/contrib/WWGbook_1.0.2.tar.gz",
    "https://cran.r-project.org/src/contrib/Archive/WWGbook/WWGbook_1.0.2.tar.gz",
    "https://cran.r-project.org/src/contrib/WWGbook_1.0.1.tar.gz",
    "https://cran.r-project.org/src/contrib/Archive/WWGbook/WWGbook_1.0.1.tar.gz",
]

CSV_NAME = "wwgbook_autism.csv"
EXTRACT_DIR = "wwgbook_extract"
PKG_DIR = "WWGbook"


def _cache_path(name: str) -> str:
    return os.path.join(CACHE, name)


def _download(url: str, dest: str) -> None:
    import requests

    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(dest), exist_ok=True)
    with requests.get(url, stream=True, timeout=120) as r:
        r.raise_for_status()
        with open(dest, "wb") as fh:
            for chunk in r.iter_content(1 << 20):
                fh.write(chunk)


def _ensure_tarball() -> str:
    for name in ("WWGbook.tar.gz", "WWGbook_1.0.2.tar.gz", "WWGbook_1.0.1.tar.gz"):
        p = _cache_path(name)
        if os.path.exists(p) and os.path.getsize(p) > 1000:
            return p
    last = None
    for url in CRAN_URLS:
        dest = _cache_path(os.path.basename(url))
        try:
            _download(url, dest)
            return dest
        except Exception as exc:  # pragma: no cover - network dependent
            last = exc
    raise RuntimeError(f"could not download WWGbook: {last}")


def _extract_rda() -> str:
    """Return path to data/autism.rda inside the extracted WWGbook source tree."""
    target = _cache_path(os.path.join(EXTRACT_DIR, PKG_DIR, "data", "autism.rda"))
    if os.path.exists(target):
        return target
    tb = _ensure_tarball()
    out = _cache_path(EXTRACT_DIR)
    os.makedirs(out, exist_ok=True)
    with tarfile.open(tb) as tf:
        members = [m for m in tf.getmembers() if m.name.endswith("data/autism.rda")]
        if not members:
            raise RuntimeError("autism.rda not found in WWGbook tarball")
        tf.extract(members[0], out)
    got = os.path.join(out, members[0].name)
    if got != target:
        os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(target), exist_ok=True)
        os.replace(got, target)
    return target


def load_autism() -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Load the WWGbook ``autism`` data frame (all 612 rows, vsae may be NA)."""
    csv = _cache_path(CSV_NAME)
    if os.path.exists(csv):
        df = pd.read_csv(csv)
        if {"childid", "age", "vsae", "sicdegp"} <= set(df.columns):
            return df
    rda = _extract_rda()
    try:
        import pyreadr

        res = pyreadr.read_r(rda)
        df = res["autism"]
    except Exception:
        import rdata

        parsed = rdata.read_rda(rda)
        df = rdata.conversion.convert(parsed["autism"])
    df = df.rename(columns={c: str(c) for c in df.columns})
    df = df[["age", "vsae", "sicdegp", "childid"]].copy()
    df["vsae"] = pd.to_numeric(df["vsae"], errors="coerce")
    for c in ("age", "sicdegp", "childid"):
        df[c] = pd.to_numeric(df[c], errors="coerce").astype("Int64")
    df.to_csv(csv, index=False)
    return df


def observed() -> pd.DataFrame:
    """The 610 observed Vineland socialization scores on 158 children."""
    df = load_autism()
    df = df.dropna(subset=["vsae", "age", "sicdegp", "childid"]).copy()
    df["age"] = df["age"].astype(int)
    df["sicdegp"] = df["sicdegp"].astype(int)
    df["childid"] = df["childid"].astype(int)
    df["vsae"] = df["vsae"].astype(float)
    return df.sort_values(["childid", "age"]).reset_index(drop=True)


def build_design(df: pd.DataFrame):
    """Transformed response/design for Eq. (13) with known weights w_it = X_it^-2.

    Returns
    -------
    y : (n,) weighted response Y / age
    X : (n, p) weighted fixed-effects design (intercept, age, group dummies)
    Z : (n, 2) weighted random-effects design (1/age, 1)
    groups : (n,) child index 0..157
    """
    n = len(df)
    age = df["age"].to_numpy(dtype=float)
    y = df["vsae"].to_numpy(dtype=float)
    grp = df["sicdegp"].to_numpy(dtype=int)
    levels = sorted(pd.unique(grp))
    cols = [np.ones(n), age]
    for lev in levels[1:]:  # treatment coding, first level as baseline
        cols.append((grp == lev).astype(float))
    X = np.column_stack(cols)
    Z = np.column_stack([np.ones(n), age])
    w = 1.0 / age  # sqrt(w_it) = 1/age
    return y * w, X * w[:, None], Z * w[:, None], df["childid"].to_numpy()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    d = observed()
    print("rows", len(d), "children", d.childid.nunique())
    print("ages", sorted(d.age.unique()))
    print("groups", d.sicdegp.value_counts().to_dict())
    y, X, Z, g = build_design(d)
    print("y", y.shape, "X", X.shape, "Z", Z.shape, "rank", np.linalg.matrix_rank(X))
    print("obs per child", np.bincount(g)[:10])

"""Linear mixed model machinery for the autism socialization example.

Model (Eq. 13 of the paper), after multiplying Y, X and Z by W^{1/2} = 1/age:

    Y_it = b1 + b2*age_it + b3'*G_i + U_1i + U_2i*age_it + E_it

with U_i ~ N(0, Psi_i), Psi_i = [[psi1, psi2], [psi2, psi3]], E ~ N(0, psi4 I)
on the weighted scale.  Marginal covariance Sigma(psi) = Z Psi Z' + psi4 I.

All inference uses the restricted likelihood (Eq. 4) with the expected
information I_jk = 0.5 tr(P~ A_j P~ A_k), P~ = Sigma^{-1} - Sigma^{-1}X(X'Sigma^{-1}X)^{-1}X'Sigma^{-1}.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import numpy as np

# H_j for j = 1, 2, 3 (A_j = Z H_j Z'); A_4 = I
H12 = np.array([[1.0, 0.0], [0.0, 0.0]])
HX = np.array([[0.0, 1.0], [1.0, 0.0]])
H22 = np.array([[0.0, 0.0], [0.0, 1.0]])
HS = (H12, HX, H22)
R = 4  # number of covariance parameters


def _pad_clusters(Z, X, y, groups):
    """Stack per-cluster blocks into padded (m, L, .) arrays."""
    m = int(groups.max()) + 1
    L = int(np.bincount(groups).max())
    p = X.shape[1]
    Zp = np.zeros((m, L, Z.shape[1]))
    Xp = np.zeros((m, L, p))
    yp = np.zeros((m, L))
    mask = np.zeros((m, L), dtype=bool)
    order = np.argsort(groups, kind="stable")
    gs = groups[order]
    starts = np.searchsorted(gs, np.arange(m))
    ends = np.searchsorted(gs, np.arange(m), side="right")
    for i in range(m):
        s, e = starts[i], ends[i]
        k = e - s
        Zp[i, :k] = Z[order[s:e]]
        Xp[i, :k] = X[order[s:e]]
        yp[i, :k] = y[order[s:e]]
        mask[i, :k] = True
    return Zp, Xp, yp, mask


class LMM:
    """REML value / score / expected information for the weighted autism model."""

    def __init__(self, y, X, Z, groups):
        self.y, self.X, self.Z, self.groups = y, X, Z, groups
        self.Zp, self.Xp, self.yp, self.mask = _pad_clusters(Z, X, y, groups)
        self.m = self.Zp.shape[0]
        self.L = self.Zp.shape[1]
        self.p = X.shape[1]
        self.n = len(y)
        self.npad = self.m * self.L - self.n
        self.K = np.einsum("mlk,mlj->mkj", self.Zp, self.Zp)  # Z_i' Z_i
        self.eyeL = np.eye(self.L)
        self.paddiag = (~self.mask).astype(float)  # 1 on padded diagonal
        self._cache = None

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ utils
    def pd_ok(self, psi):
        """Sigma(psi) positive definite  <=>  psi4 I_2 + Psi K_i > 0 for all i."""
        psi1, psi2, psi3, psi4 = psi
        if not (psi4 > 0):
            return False
        Psi = np.array([[psi1, psi2], [psi2, psi3]])
        M = psi4 * np.eye(2)[None, :, :] + Psi[None, :, :] @ self.K
        ev = np.linalg.eigvalsh(M)
        return bool(ev.min() > 0)

    def sigma_inv_blocks(self, psi):
        """Batched inverse of the padded marginal covariance (m, L, L)."""
        psi1, psi2, psi3, psi4 = psi
        Psi = np.array([[psi1, psi2], [psi2, psi3]])
        Sig = self.Zp @ Psi @ self.Zp.transpose(0, 2, 1)
        Sig = Sig + (psi4 * self.eyeL + np.diag(self.paddiag[0]) * 0.0)[None, :, :]
        Sig = Sig + psi4 * self.eyeL[None, :, :]
        Sig = Sig + np.apply_along_axis(np.diag, -1, self.paddiag)
        return np.linalg.inv(Sig)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------- evaluation
    def evaluate(self, psi):
        """Return dict with REML log-likelihood, score and expected information."""
        psi = np.asarray(psi, dtype=float)
        if not self.pd_ok(psi):
            return None
        psi1, psi2, psi3, psi4 = psi
        Psi = np.array([[psi1, psi2], [psi2, psi3]])
        Zp, Xp, yp = self.Zp, self.Xp, self.yp

        Sig = Zp @ Psi @ Zp.transpose(0, 2, 1)
        Sig = Sig + psi4 * self.eyeL[None, :, :]
        Sig = Sig + np.einsum("ml,lm->mlm", self.paddiag, self.eyeL)
        Si = np.linalg.inv(Sig)
        Si2 = Si @ Si
        Si4 = Si2 @ Si2

        Zt = Zp.transpose(0, 2, 1)
        Xt = Xp.transpose(0, 2, 1)
        M = np.einsum("mki,mkl,mlj->mij", Zt, Si, Zp)          # Z' Sigma^-1 Z
        M2 = np.einsum("mki,mkl,mlj->mij", Zt, Si2, Zp)         # Z' Sigma^-2 Z

def _sigma(self, psi):
        """Padded marginal covariance blocks (m, L, L); padded part is identity."""
        psi1, psi2, psi3, psi4 = psi
        Psi = np.array([[psi1, psi2], [psi2, psi3]])
        Sig = self.Zp @ Psi @ self.Zp.transpose(0, 2, 1)
        Sig = Sig + psi4 * self.eyeL[None, :, :]
        Sig = Sig + self.paddiag[:, :, None] * self.eyeL[None, :, :]
        return Sig

    def pd_ok(self, psi):

"""Linear mixed model machinery for the autism socialization example (Section 5.1).

Model (Eq. 13 of the paper), after multiplying Y, X and Z by W^{1/2} = 1/age:

    Y_it = b1 + b2*age_it + b3'*G_i + U_1i + U_2i*age_it + E_it

with U_i ~ N(0, Psi_i), Psi_i = [[psi1, psi2], [psi2, psi3]], E ~ N(0, psi4 I)
on the weighted scale.  Marginal covariance Sigma(psi) = Z Psi Z' + psi4 I.

All inference uses the restricted likelihood (Eq. 4).  With

    P = Sigma^{-1} - Sigma^{-1} X (X' Sigma^{-1} X)^{-1} X' Sigma^{-1}

the restricted score and the *expected* information are

    S_j   = 0.5 * (r' P A_j P r - tr(P A_j))
    I_jk  = 0.5 * tr(P A_j P A_k)

with A_j = Z H_j Z' (H_1 = e1e1', H_2 = e1e2' + e2e1', H_3 = e2e2') and A_4 = I.
Observed information is deliberately *not* used (requirement R4).
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import numpy as np

# H_j for j = 1, 2, 3 (A_j = Z H_j Z'); A_4 = I
H12 = np.array([[1.0, 0.0], [0.0, 0.0]])
HX = np.array([[0.0, 1.0], [1.0, 0.0]])
H22 = np.array([[0.0, 0.0], [0.0, 1.0]])
HS = (H12, HX, H22)
R = 4  # number of covariance parameters


class LMM:
    """REML value / score / expected information for the weighted autism model."""

    def __init__(self, y, X, Z, groups=None):
        self.y = np.asarray(y, float)
        self.X = np.asarray(X, float)
        self.Z = np.asarray(Z, float)
        self.groups = groups
        self.n, self.p = self.X.shape
        self.q = self.Z.shape[1]
        # A_j are constant in psi: precompute the dense n x n derivative matrices.
        self.A = [self.Z @ H @ self.Z.T for H in HS] + [np.eye(self.n)]
        self._chol_cache = {}

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ pieces
    def sigma(self, psi):
        psi1, psi2, psi3, psi4 = (float(v) for v in psi)
        Psi = np.array([[psi1, psi2], [psi2, psi3]])
        return self.Z @ Psi @ self.Z.T + psi4 * np.eye(self.n)

    def pd_ok(self, psi):
        """Sigma(psi) positive definite (Cholesky of the n x n matrix succeeds)."""
        try:
            np.linalg.cholesky(self.sigma(psi))
        except np.linalg.LinAlgError:
            return False
        return True

    # ------------------------------------------------------------- evaluation
    def reml(self, psi):
        """REML log-likelihood, restricted score and expected information.

        Returns None when Sigma(psi) is not positive definite.
        """
        psi = np.asarray(psi, float)
        Sig = self.sigma(psi)
        try:
            np.linalg.cholesky(Sig)
        except np.linalg.LinAlgError:
            return None
        Si = np.linalg.inv(Sig)
        X, y, Z = self.X, self.y, self.Z

        XtX = X.T @ Si @ X                      # p x p
        G = np.linalg.inv(XtX)
        beta = G @ (X.T @ Si @ y)
        r = y - X @ beta                        # restricted residuals
        # P = Si - Si X G X' Si ; only Z'PZ and Z'Pr are needed.
        SiX = Si @ X                            # n x p
        ZtSi = Z.T @ Si                         # q x n
        B = ZtSi @ Z - (ZtSi @ X) @ G @ (X.T @ Si @ Z)   # q x q  = Z' P Z
        v = ZtSi @ r                            # q      = Z' P r  (Z'PX = 0)
        trSi = float(np.trace(Si))
        quad = float(r @ Si @ r)

        sign, ld = np.linalg.slogdet(Sig)
        sign2, ld2 = np.linalg.slogdet(XtX)
        loglik = -0.5 * (ld + ld2 + quad)

        # ---- restricted score -------------------------------------------------
        S = np.zeros(R)
        for j in range(3):
            Hj = HS[j]
            S[j] = 0.5 * (v @ Hj @ v - np.trace(Hj @ B))
        S[3] = 0.5 * (quad - trSi + self.p)

        # ---- expected information --------------------------------------------
        I = np.zeros((R, R))
        for j in range(R):
            for k in range(j, R):
                if j < 3 and k < 3:
                    val = 0.5 * np.trace(HS[j] @ B @ HS[k] @ B)
                elif j < 3:  # k == 3
                    val = 0.5 * np.trace(HS[j] @ B)
                else:
                    val = 0.5 * (trSi - self.p)
                I[j, k] = val
                I[k, j] = val
        return dict(
            loglik=float(loglik),
            score=S,
            info=I,
            beta=beta,
            B=B,
            v=v,
            trSi=trSi,
            quad=quad,
            pd=True,
        )

    def reml_dense(self, psi):
        """Literal dense implementation with explicit P and A_j (verification)."""
        psi = np.asarray(psi, float)
        Sig = self.sigma(psi)
        try:
            np.linalg.cholesky(Sig)
        except np.linalg.LinAlgError:
            return None
        Si = np.linalg.inv(Sig)
        X, y = self.X, self.y
        G = np.linalg.inv(X.T @ Si @ X)
        beta = G @ (X.T @ Si @ y)
        r = y - X @ beta
        P = Si - Si @ X @ G @ X.T @ Si
        Pr = P @ r
        S = np.array([0.5 * (Pr @ self.A[j] @ Pr - np.trace(P @ self.A[j]))
                      for j in range(R)])
        I = np.zeros((R, R))
        for j in range(R):
            for k in range(j, R):
                val = 0.5 * np.trace(P @ self.A[j] @ P @ self.A[k])
                I[j, k] = val
                I[k, j] = val
        sign, ld = np.linalg.slogdet(Sig)
        sign2, ld2 = np.linalg.slogdet(X.T @ Si @ X)
        loglik = -0.5 * (ld + ld2 + float(r @ Si @ r))
        return dict(loglik=float(loglik), score=S, info=I, beta=beta, pd=True)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------- optimizer
    def _neg(self, psi):
        out = self.reml(psi)
        if out is None:
            return 1e12, np.zeros(R)
        return -out["loglik"], -out["score"]

        Hessian (requirement R11), with backtracking and a Nelder-Mead polish."""

"""Linear mixed model machinery for the autism socialization example (Section 5.1).

Model (Eq. 13 of the paper), after multiplying Y, X and Z by W^{1/2} = 1/age:

    Y_it = b1 + b2*age_it + b3'*G_i + U_1i + U_2i*age_it + E_it

with U_i ~ N(0, Psi_i), Psi_i = [[psi1, psi2], [psi2, psi3]], E ~ N(0, psi4 I)
on the weighted scale.  Marginal covariance Sigma(psi) = Z Psi Z' + psi4 I.

All inference uses the restricted likelihood (Eq. 4).  Following Appendix B of
the paper, with

    G = (X' Sigma^{-1} X)^{-1},   P = X G X' Sigma^{-1},   Q = I - P,
    beta~ = G X' Sigma^{-1} Y,    R = Y - X beta~ = Q Y,

the restricted score (Eq. 34-35) and the *expected* information (Eq. 36) are

    S_j   = 0.5 * ( w' H_j w - tr(H_j T) )            j = 1, 2, 3
    S_4   = 0.5 * ( R' Sigma^{-2} R - tr(Sigma^{-1}) + tr(G X' Sigma^{-2} X) )
    I_jk  = 0.5 * tr(T H_j T H_k)                     j, k <= 3
    I_j4  = 0.5 * tr(U H_j)
    I_44  = 0.5 * tr(Q Sigma^{-1} Q Sigma^{-1})

with w = Z' Sigma^{-1} R, T = Z' Sigma^{-1} Q Z, U = Z' Sigma^{-1} Q Sigma^{-1} Q Z
and H_1 = e1e1', H_2 = e1e2' + e2e1', H_3 = e2e2' (A_j = Z H_j Z', A_4 = I).
Observed information is deliberately *not* used (requirement R4).
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import numpy as np

H12 = np.array([[1.0, 0.0], [0.0, 0.0]])
HX = np.array([[0.0, 1.0], [1.0, 0.0]])
H22 = np.array([[0.0, 0.0], [0.0, 1.0]])
HS = (H12, HX, H22)
R = 4  # number of covariance parameters


class LMM:
    """REML value / restricted score / expected information (flat n x n form)."""

    def __init__(self, y, X, Z, groups=None):
        self.y = np.asarray(y, float)
        self.X = np.asarray(X, float)
        self.Z = np.asarray(Z, float)
        self.groups = groups
        self.n, self.p = self.X.shape
        self.q = self.Z.shape[1]
        self.In = np.eye(self.n)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ pieces
    def sigma(self, psi):
        psi1, psi2, psi3, psi4 = (float(v) for v in psi)
        Psi = np.array([[psi1, psi2], [psi2, psi3]])
        return self.Z @ Psi @ self.Z.T + psi4 * self.In

    def pd_ok(self, psi):
        """Sigma(psi) positive definite (Cholesky of the n x n matrix succeeds)."""
        try:
            np.linalg.cholesky(self.sigma(psi))
        except np.linalg.LinAlgError:
            return False
        return True

    # ------------------------------------------------------------- evaluation
    def reml(self, psi):
        """REML log-likelihood, restricted score and expected information.

        Returns None when Sigma(psi) is not positive definite.
        """
        psi = np.asarray(psi, float)
        Sig = self.sigma(psi)
        try:
            np.linalg.cholesky(Sig)
        except np.linalg.LinAlgError:
            return None
        X, y, Z = self.X, self.y, self.Z
        Si = np.linalg.inv(Sig)
        SiX = Si @ X                      # n x p
        SiZ = Si @ Z                      # n x q
        SiY = Si @ y                      # n
        Si2X = Si @ SiX                   # n x p
        Si2Z = Si @ SiZ                   # n x q
        Si2Y = Si @ SiY                   # n

        X1 = X.T @ SiX                    # p x p   X' Sigma^-1 X
        X2 = SiX.T @ SiX                  # p x p   X' Sigma^-2 X
        X3 = SiX.T @ Si2X                 # p x p   X' Sigma^-3 X
        G = np.linalg.inv(X1)
        beta = G @ (X.T @ SiY)
        R = y - X @ beta                  # restricted residuals (= Q Y)

        # ---- restricted score (Eq. 34-35) ------------------------------------
        w = Z.T @ SiY - (Z.T @ SiX) @ beta            # q   = Z' Sigma^-1 R
        M = Z.T @ SiZ                                 # q x q
        V = Z.T @ SiX                                 # q x p
        T = M - V @ G @ V.T                           # q x q = Z' Sigma^-1 Q Z
        S = np.zeros(R)
        for j in range(3):
            S[j] = 0.5 * (w @ HS[j] @ w - np.trace(HS[j] @ T))
        S[3] = 0.5 * (float(Si2Y @ Si2Y) - float(np.trace(Si))
                      + float(np.trace(G @ X2)))

        # ---- expected information (Eq. 36) ----------------------------------
        I = np.zeros((R, R))
        for j in range(3):
            for k in range(j, 3):
                val = 0.5 * np.trace(T @ HS[j] @ T @ HS[k])
                I[j, k] = val
                I[k, j] = val
        M2 = SiZ.T @ SiZ                  # q x q   Z' Sigma^-2 Z
        V2 = SiZ.T @ SiX                  # q x p   Z' Sigma^-2 X
        U = (M2 - V2 @ G @ V.T - V @ G @ V2.T + V @ G @ X2 @ G @ V.T)
        for j in range(3):
            I[j, 3] = 0.5 * np.trace(U @ HS[j])
            I[3, j] = I[j, 3]
        I[3, 3] = 0.5 * (float(np.sum(Si * Si)) - 2.0 * float(np.trace(G @ X3))
                         + float(np.trace(G @ X2 @ G @ X2)))

        sign, ld = np.linalg.slogdet(Sig)
        sign2, ld2 = np.linalg.slogdet(X1)
        loglik = -0.5 * (ld + ld2 + float(R @ SiY))
        return dict(loglik=float(loglik), score=S, info=I, beta=beta, pd=True)

    def reml_dense(self, psi):
        """Literal dense implementation of Appendix B (verification only)."""
        psi = np.asarray(psi, float)

        except np.linalg.LinAlgError:
